capability_bounds.gaussian: Real erf/erfc; exact rational monotone enclosures, complete original-source first/second derivative chains, direct requested precision at most 256 decimal digits. Positive complementary tails through 32 retain relative precision; larger positive arguments have absolute saturation bounds. Approximate binary64 compilation remains distinct from exact rational certification.
capability_bounds.pde: Rational constant a*u_x+b*u_y+c*u with nonzero transport and at most 16 affine exponential/trigonometric modes; rational polynomial amplitudes of degree at most 16 and at most 192 monomials. Exact resonance uses characteristic integration. Independent source-bound coefficient checking validates a solution family, not general PDE completeness or boundary/initial conditions.
capability_bounds.exponential_budget: Prepay magnitude-dependent Taylor/rounding/squaring work for every exact endpoint on the original ledger. Unchanged intrinsic and caller limits can refuse expensive absolute enclosures before the kernel runs; protected verifier reserve is unchanged.
